guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data tables and code blocks without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Set min-inline-size:0 / min-width:0 on flex items containing long unbreakable content (code, URLs) so they shrink instead of spilling; use overflow:auto so a scrollbar appears only when content truly overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verified applied: the <pre> code blocks and .doc-table wrap/scroll within the viewport on the 360px matrix pass, so no min-width fix was required (evidence: mobile screenshot + no-horizontal-overflow-mobile pass).
